hero.alt: The intersection of Collins Street and Reynolds Street in historic downtown Plant City, with both street signs visible on the Heritage Law Group corner building
hero.caption: Historic downtown Plant City at Collins Street and Reynolds Street, on the Christmas parade route. This is a daytime street scene, not the parade or holiday lights.
hero.author: Ebyabe
hero.modificationNotice: Resized, cropped to 1280 by 853 and converted to WebP. The adaptation is released under the same licence.
hero.verification: Commons file Plant_City_FL_Downtown_Comm_Dist01.JPG is titled as downtown Plant City, credited to Ebyabe under CC BY-SA 3.0, dated 26 February 2011, native 3264 x 2448. Direct inspection of the original shows readable Collins Street and Reynolds Street signs on the Heritage Law Group corner. The 2026 Plant City Christmas Parade route uses Collins Street and Reynolds Street; the parade itself is not pictured. One adult pedestrian is at the far right edge and is not the subject. No recognizable children. No overlays or watermarks. This replaces a reused Marie Selby Botanical Gardens photograph that was captioned as not Plant City.

Direct inspection shows the Plant City Welcome Center Historic Downtown sign on the depot canopy, the brick walk, and tracks. The depot stands at 102 N Palmer St, immediately beside McCall Park at 100 N Collins St, the Lights of Love site. The tree is not pictured. No recognizable children. No overlays or watermarks.

Apollo Beach Lighted Boat Parade.author: Tampa Sailing Squadron
Apollo Beach Lighted Boat Parade.verification: Viewed the JPEG: an overhead daytime drone still of the Tampa Sailing Squadron clubhouse (white building with a gray roof), the parking lot, a row of dry-sailed dinghies, and the docks and basin behind the clubhouse. One person stands beside a car in the lot, seen from almost directly above; no face is visible and no children are in the frame. No logos, overlays or watermarks. The still is the official Facilities page photo at tampasailingsquadron.com (module_id=244594), filename dji_fly_20240209_151804_56, taken 9 February 2024. Two further official gallery stills from the Welcome to TSS album (album 255795, photographer Lem Berkstresser) show the same basin and docks, with the TECO Big Bend plant visible across the water, confirming Apollo Beach; they are used in the event gallery, not as the cover. Gabe authorized a verified Tampa Sailing Squadron website photo for this pick, credited Photo: Tampa Sailing Squadron, on 23 November 2026 at 1:37 PM ET. The official gallery's Boat Parade category is empty, and the 2022 through 2026 event pages carry no stills of the lighted boats, so the allowed clubhouse and basin fallback is used.
